candidates.source_title: Women were not merely background figures in nomadic history🏹🐎 #mulan #mongolia
candidates.source_description:
One detail in Mulan is often overlooked.

When Mulan reveals her identity, Shan Yu isn’t shocked that she is a woman. He still recognizes her as “the soldier from the mountains”, a warrior first and foremost.

Whether intentional or not, that moment reflects something seen across many steppe societies, including the Mongols and the Huns.
